limits: Short input prompts: 30, 39, and 41 tokens; 256 generated tokens per request.
One warmup per prompt; two measured repeats. Source build stopped during both runs.
End-to-end output rates include request latency; these are not long-context throughput measurements.
Changing DSpark changes draft memory and remaining KV allocation; common memory-utilization and context settings are equal.
A small synthetic benchmark is not a broad quality or performance evaluation.
